visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed rotating hero of landscape images with prev/next arrows and dot indicators, no text overlay
visualCharacteristics.layout: one slide visible at a time, image covers the slide, arrows centred vertically, dots overlaid at the bottom

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = slide image (picture, image link or plain-text image URL, used as authored); cell 2 = optional slide text (heading, description, CTA), left empty for image-only slides

usage: Image-only full-width hero carousel at the top of a page (5 slides on the WKND Travel home page).
reuseGuidance: Use for any full-width rotating image strip. For slides with text overlays the same block works: fill cell 2. For a static single image use hero instead.
